correctness.rationale: The proof is sound assuming the stated transitive-family first-jet theorem. Distinct members cannot be tangent because a point-hyperplane pair determines a unique leaf. The parameter first-jet isomorphism makes every nonzero infinitesimal normal variation transverse and identifies nearby zero sets with an equator or projective hyperplane. The total pair-incidence projection is a proper submersion; nonempty open-and-closed image in the connected punctured parameter space gives surjectivity, and Ehresmann gives constant fiber type and isotopy.
